summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds class Update(prologue, algebra) beside Query; rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py translateUpdate now always returns an Update (empty-request path builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] via translatePrologue, then returns an empty algebra), and imports Update; rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update container; rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) after prepareQuery, recording _original_args; rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate; test/test_sparql_prepare.py is a new test module covering the spec's behaviours, including a snapshot-based no-mutation check. Nothing was run, per instructions, so all tests are unverified. Not committed. Open item: the empty-string path assumes parseUpdate("") yields one prologue group, which should be confirmed when the suite runs.
